plan.title: Service and Hierarchical Events Buyer-role access

steps.note: Reach the sourcing events area before the role-specific access check.
Confirm the events list is available and rendered without an application error.

args.need: Sign in as the non-Buyer user and the Buyer on the same Enterprise tenant, attempt Service & Hierarchical Events to get an eRFX for services with hierarchical scope for each role, and compare whether the action is refused or offered.

steps.note: The catalog has no alternate-role login or Service & Hierarchical Events action, so the tester must perform and compare the role-specific behavior.
Leave the plan with a known-screen assertion after the tester interaction.
